integrity: Contains complete standalone Python 3 standard-library verification code and its recorded quantitative output. Exact integer unit elimination and full gradient-acyclicity validation support the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to one explicitly defined finite bidirected graph; no full homotopy wedge decomposition, infinite-family theorem, or independently audited correctness/novelty is asserted. Unindexed prior equivalent work remains possible.
title: Integral homology in four consecutive degrees for the bidirected Petersen multipath complex
